name: vision-pro
description: Vision-Pro — turn an iPad into an advanced remote interface for a Mac.

scripts.dev:mac: npm run build -w @vision-pro/ipad && npm run tauri -w @vision-pro/desktop -- dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @vision-pro/ipad && npm run build -w @vision-pro/desktop
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && npm run tauri -w @vision-pro/desktop -- build
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run build:web && npm run tauri -w @vision-pro/desktop -- build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.agent: npm run build -w @vision-pro/ipad && cargo run --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --bin vp-agentd --
scripts.test:agent: npm run build -w @vision-pro/ipad && cargo test --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --workspace
